relations.name: if-true
relations.rationale: A constant-true IF has the same marker multiset as its then branch; the else branch never runs.
relations.dsl_a: df.if($c$SELECT true$c$, df.sql($mk$SELECT public.df_gen_mark('meta-0002-a', 'r.a')$mk$), df.sql($mk$SELECT public.df_gen_mark('meta-0002-a', 'r.b')$mk$))

relations.name: if-false
relations.rationale: A constant-false IF has the same marker multiset as its else branch; the then branch never runs.
relations.dsl_a: df.if($c$SELECT false$c$, df.sql($mk$SELECT public.df_gen_mark('meta-0003-a', 'r.a')$mk$), df.sql($mk$SELECT public.df_gen_mark('meta-0003-a', 'r.b')$mk$))

relations.name: join-comm
relations.rationale: Swapping independent JOIN branches preserves their marker multiset, not their completion order or aggregate result array.

relations.name: race-winner
relations.rationale: A marker racing a 30-second sleep has the winner-only marker multiset, provided the marker completes before the timer.

relations.name: do-while-once
relations.rationale: A do-while loop with a false condition after its first body run has the single-body marker multiset.
relations.dsl_a: df.loop(df.sql($mk$SELECT public.df_gen_mark('meta-0006-a', 'r.a')$mk$), $c$SELECT count(*) < 1 FROM public.df_gen_trace WHERE shape_id = 'meta-0006-a' AND node_path = 'r.a'$c$)

relations.name: loop-break-once
relations.rationale: A loop breaking immediately after its first body run has the single-body marker multiset, without equating final return values.
